name: Federal National Data Center (Mogadishu)
developer: Federal Government of Somalia / Ministry of Communications and Technology (MOCT), SCALED-UP (World Bank P168115)
notes: Federal administration. MOCT: minister toured the NDC under construction Apr 2024; May 2025 site visit reported construction nearing completion; 2025 facility-engineer and project-manager REOIs (SO-MOF-425074-CS-INDV, SO-MOF-374369-GO-RFB) signal operations planning. Aug 2026 Dawan 'plans' statement conflicts with the 2024-2025 construction record and is treated as a next-phase/expansion lead (B/C). Capacity not published.

name: Hormuud Telecom data center network (11 sites, ~10 MW portfolio)
notes: CEO statements (Bloomberg/DCD Dec 2024, mirrored by Stallion Times/Garowe Online) cite 11 data centers with combined ~10 MW capacity and up to 95% daytime solar. Portfolio-level claim; per-site addresses/capacities not published. Mogadishu (Banaadir) is the core hub; the DARE1 cable landing station (completed Nov 2022) is an interconnect anchor, not a DC. Do not mint 11 facility records from the aggregate (methodology rule).

name: SomaliREN data centre
notes: Federal administration. SomaliREN operates a data centre at the TCC Building, Taleh Road, Hodan District, Mogadishu (Banaadir), serving 33 member institutions by 2026; education/research network DC (AFRINIC org record AS328363), not commercial colocation. Capacity not published.

name: OADC Mogadishu data center (planned, WIOCC Group)
developer: Open Access Data Centres (OADC) / WIOCC Group
notes: DCD (Nov 2021): WIOCC's OADC unit planned a carrier-neutral data center at its Mogadishu subsea cable landing (first-phase locations incl. Lagos and Durban) after a USD 200m capital raise. No completion or current-status evidence found in this pass; status remains announced.

name: NIRA national digital identity infrastructure (HUBIYE/CDS/eAqoonsi; ABIS at Aden Adde)
developer: National Identification and Registration Authority (NIRA) / World Bank Scaled-UP
notes: Government/identity category, not commercial DC. HUBIYE verifier, Certificate Delivery System and eAqoonsi app in Mogadishu (A); World Bank mass-registration pilot launched Aug 18 2025 in Shangani/Boondheer districts (A). ABIS law-enforcement biometric system with a secure facility at Aden Adde International Airport (2,000,000 ten-print + 50,000 latent records, secondary backup server) is a separate B/C lead (Biometric Update/HigherGov mirror of FBI RFI).

name: Eurosom data center / cloud (Mogadishu)
notes: Company marketing claims a Mogadishu data center hub for its enterprise cloud services (hubs in London, Sharjah, Mogadishu); no independent facility specification, capacity or status evidence. Unverified provider claim.

name: ATAL Networks Mogadishu VPS data center
notes: Hosting-provider marketing page for a 'Mogadishu data center' VPS service; no facility specification or independent verification. Unverified.

name: Wingu Africa Berbera SL01 carrier-neutral data center
notes: Somaliland administration; physically in Sahil (Berbera), assigned to Northwest per the manifest with a Sahil note. First phase commissioned 13 Feb 2021, ready for service per Wingu announcement (Feb 2022) and the Somaliland MOIID page; PeeringDB facility 13450 lists Batalaale Beach, Zone 20 / Beach Road, Berbera, with Somcable ASN 37425. First/only commercial carrier-neutral colo in Somaliland. ~1 MW figure is Baxtel (C). Wingu's current homepage markets Djibouti/Ethiopia/Tanzania; direct re-verification of operating status recommended.

name: Somaliland Government Data and Cybersecurity Center / National Data Center (Hargeisa)
developer: Somaliland Ministry of Information and Communication Technology (MICT) with TaiwanICDF / Taiwan Technical Mission
notes: Somaliland administration. TaiwanICDF primary page: groundbreaking 22 Sep 2025 at MICT in Hargeisa for Somaliland's first government data center, with server facilities, cybersecurity management systems, S-Road/e-governance linkage and planned ISO/IEC 27001 support; press reprints report ~USD 1M project value (B). Construction phase; capacity not published.

name: Somtel FGC data centre / colocation portfolio (3 data centers claimed)
notes: Somaliland administration. Operator pages claim colocation data-center facilities and '3 Data Centers' (Hargeisa HQ; landing points at Mogadishu, Bosaso, Wajaale, Djibouti, Mombasa and planned Berbera 2025). Portfolio/service claim only; individual physical sites not verified in this pass. The Jan 2024 first-5G launch is a network rollout, not a DC record.
